the use of a KT plate in revision THA may not be a reliable option in patients with type IV acetabular bone defect.
revision THA with a KT plate has a high failure rate when the acetabular bone defect is type IV, especially in the presence of bulk allograft.

the β-TCP graft group had a significantly higher survival rate than the bulk allograph group, and that the survival rate in the American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons type IV defect group was lower than in the other defect groups.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the KT plate is a reliable device for the treatment of aseptic loosened acetabular components, but it is necessary to pay more attention to the type of bone graft material used in revision surgery.
acetabular reconstruction using a KT plate is a useful option for patients with acetabular bone defect, especially when the bone defect is small.
β-TCP may be an appropriate bone graft substitute for acetabular reconstruction with a KT plate.
